Sealed r120 as **PREFREEZE: no frozen target, no nominee**.

The spherical stopping calculation is retained as support. The full Artin algorithm still lacks a terminating capped-layer eligibility test over spherical cosets. Other screens and late historical antecedents are documented in the [report](/home/mj-kang/Documents/Dev/math/openai-proof-research/frontier/campaigns/2026-10-14/fresh-structural-discovery-r120/REPORT.md).
